summary: Reconstruct NVFP4-CSF scale operands inside dynamic expert kernels
compatibility: Canonical checkpoint bytes, FP32 calibration and A4 arithmetic are unchanged. Preparation retunes its versioned decoder choice; no launch flag changes are required.
details: Typed preparation selects complete-plane expansion or cooperative reconstruction in shared operand slots. N64 intermediate tails are supported.
Short-route expansion uses equal-size output spans and the prepared exception-word index. Scratch remains caller-owned and graph replay does not allocate.
The serving report records measured concurrency, hardware, source identities and remaining overhead; component decoder timings alone do not establish model throughput.
